verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch7.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); World Bank regions (Sub-Saharan Africa, Middle East & North Africa, Latin America & Caribbean)
verification.result: All 3,149 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; Argentina's inflation is shown for 2024, the last year in the World Bank series, and Ethiopia's remittances for 2024; unsourced wording (an 'exchange-rate regime change' and 'birr liberalised' note for Ethiopia, 'few economies swing as much' for Argentina, a 'mostly' judgement for Colombia) was removed before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
